lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: High-luminance circular spots are positioned at the intersections of faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity and horizontal rows on the posterior flank and caudal peduncle.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Linear features running horizontally across the upper flank exhibit a sharp vertical gradient, with high-intensity pixels on the upper edge and lower-intensity shadow pixels on the lower edge, converging toward the tail.

other_distinctive_markers: The upper lobe of the caudal fin displays a series of broad, alternating vertical bands of varying pixel intensity.
